preset.reference_title: EuroHPC JU Call for Proposals - Extreme Scale Access Mode
preset.summary: Largest allocations on EuroHPC supercomputers for high-impact research, peer reviewed after each cut-off.

call.name: Extreme Scale Access
call.description: Access to the largest partitions of the hosting entities' systems for projects of high scientific impact. Proposals are evaluated together after each cut-off: administrative check, technical assessment per partition, two rapporteurs, three scientific reviews, the applicant's response, the rapporteurs' reports, and the committee's ranking before the allocation decision.

proposal_roles.name: Rapporteur
proposal_roles.description: A panel member who follows the proposal through evaluation. Each proposal has two: the Lead Rapporteur, marked as the lead, and the Second Rapporteur.

workflow_steps.name: Administrative check
workflow_steps.description: The call managers check that the proposal is eligible and complete.

workflow_steps.name: Technical assessment
workflow_steps.description: The team of each requested partition assesses whether the proposal can run there: accepted, conditionally accepted or rejected. A rejected partition does not stop the proposal.

workflow_steps.name: Rapporteur assignment
workflow_steps.description: Alongside the technical assessment, the chair or vice-chair of the Access Resource Committee assigns two panel members as the proposal's rapporteurs, one of them marked as the Lead Rapporteur, the other being the Second Rapporteur. Each confirms having no conflict of interest.

workflow_steps.name: Rapporteurs' questions and reviewer suggestions
workflow_steps.description: Each rapporteur reads the proposal, writes their questions to the applicant and suggests scientific reviewers for it.

evaluators.active: Pending Reviewer suggestions and ARC Questions
evaluators.completed: Reviewer suggestions and ARC Questions submitted

workflow_steps.name: Scientific reviewer assignment
workflow_steps.description: The call managers invite the suggested reviewers to the call's reviewer pool and assign three scientific reviewers to the proposal.

workflow_steps.name: Scientific review
workflow_steps.description: Three scientific reviewers review the proposal independently, without seeing each other's reviews.

call_team.active: Under Scientific Evaluation - {invited} reviewers invited, {accepted} accepted, {declined} declined, {submitted} reviews submitted

criteria.name: Quality and efficiency of the implementation

workflow_steps.name: Response to reviews
workflow_steps.description: The applicant reads the scientific reviews and the rapporteurs' questions and responds to them.

workflow_steps.name: Individual reports
workflow_steps.description: Each rapporteur writes an individual report from the technical assessment, the reviews, their questions and the applicant's response.

workflow_steps.name: Consolidated report
workflow_steps.description: The Lead Rapporteur consolidates both individual reports into one report. Once released, the applicant reads it as the committee's feedback.

workflow_steps.name: Committee meeting
workflow_steps.description: Run once per round: the call managers open it for the round once the round's proposals have reached it. The Access Resource Committee discusses, grades and ranks the proposals of the cut-off; its chair and vice-chair each write a round report on the meeting's outcome, and the final scores, overall ranking and resource recommendations are recorded on the round. The step completes once both reports are submitted; the call managers then open the final feedback.

workflow_steps.name: Final feedback
workflow_steps.description: After the committee meeting the Lead Rapporteur writes the feedback for the applicant on the proposal. Once released, the applicant reads it with the allocation decision.

workflow_steps.name: Allocation decision
workflow_steps.description: The Resource Allocation Panel decides the award, following the committee's ranking, and the call managers record each proposal's result. The Governing Board then adopts the list on the round, before its results are published.

workflow_steps.name: Award response
workflow_steps.description: The applicant accepts or declines the award before resources are created.

workflow_steps.name: Extension request
workflow_steps.description: An awarded applicant asks to extend the project: the circumstances and the resource usage so far, the new end date and the resources needed. Asked at the latest one month before the project ends.

workflow_steps.name: Extension request assessment
workflow_steps.description: The team of each partition hosting the project assesses whether the extension is valid and can be accepted: accepted, conditionally accepted or rejected. Only a partition whose team accepts takes the extension.

workflow_steps.name: Extension request results
workflow_steps.description: The call managers decide the extension following the assessment: the end date and resources granted. An approved extension moves the project's end date; more resources are ordered from the partitions, whose providers approve the orders as usual.

workflow_steps.name: Final report
workflow_steps.description: The awarded applicant submits the project's final report. The step opens at the end of the allocation period, an extension included.

workflow_steps.name: Final report approval
workflow_steps.description: The call managers approve the final report, which completes the project.

checklists.name: Rapporteurs' questions
checklists.description: Questions a rapporteur puts to the applicant after reading the proposal.

questions.user_guidance: The applicant reads these questions and answers them in the response to reviews. Leave empty if you have no questions.

checklists.name: Response to reviews
checklists.description: The applicant's response to the scientific reviews and the rapporteurs' questions.

questions.description: Response to the reviews and questions
questions.user_guidance: Answer the rapporteurs' questions and comment on the scientific reviews. The rapporteurs read your response before writing their reports.
Optional. One PDF file, for example figures or tables referred to in the response.

checklists.name: Individual report
checklists.description: A rapporteur's own assessment of the proposal, written before the reports are consolidated.

questions.user_guidance: Assess the proposal in the light of the technical assessment, the scientific reviews and the applicant's response.

questions.description: Score: Quality and efficiency of the implementation

checklists.name: Consolidated report
checklists.description: The lead rapporteur's consolidated report, graded on the three criteria. Once released, the applicant reads it.

questions.user_guidance: Summarise the evaluation for the applicant. The applicant reads this text once the report is released.
The rapporteurs' recommendation to the committee.
The conditions the allocation should be subject to.

questions.description: Score: Quality and efficiency of the implementation

checklists.name: ARC meeting report
checklists.description: The Access Resource Committee's meeting for the proposals of the cut-off. The final scores, overall rank and recommendations are entered in the round's ranking.

questions.user_guidance: The committee's discussion of the proposals at the ARC meeting.

checklists.name: Final feedback
checklists.description: The feedback the applicant reads once it is released.

questions.user_guidance: Summarise the evaluation for the applicant. The applicant reads this text once the feedback is released.

checklists.name: Extension request
checklists.description: Why an awarded project needs more time or resources.

questions.user_guidance: Describe what happened that calls for an extension, and what the extension lets the project finish.
Summarise how the allocated resources have been used up to now on each partition.

checklists.name: Final report
checklists.description: The results of an awarded project once its allocation ends.

questions.user_guidance: Report what the project achieved with the allocated resources, including publications and outcomes.
Optional. One PDF file with the full report.

scenarios.name: Happy path
scenarios.description: Every step passes and the applicant accepts the award.

scenarios.name: Rejected at the administrative check
scenarios.description: The office finds the proposal ineligible: it is rejected, the applicant is told and no other step runs.

scenarios.name: Changes requested at the administrative check
scenarios.description: The office asks for changes, the applicant submits them and the proposal is then found eligible; the technical assessment starts together with the rapporteur assignment.

actions.message: Please complete the Project Scope and Plan.

scenarios.name: Extension and final report
scenarios.description: After the award the applicant team asks for an extension, the partitions accept it and it is approved; at the end the final report is submitted and approved.

scenarios.name: No response to the reviews
scenarios.description: The applicant lets the response phase lapse: the response is not mandatory, so the rapporteurs' individual reports start.
